scenes.vo: This is an office. And everyone in it is an AI agent.
Right now, they're walking into their daily standup.
What if your AI agents worked like a real team... one you could actually see?
Meet Pantheon. An open-source office for AI agents.
Every agent is a character in a live 3D world. You can see who's thinking, who's working, and who's talking to whom.
They plan the work, hand out tasks, and review each other, on a real board.
Just describe a goal. Zeus, the built-in supervisor, designs the whole team for you.
They can even teach you, with animations, a shared whiteboard, and their own voices.
And every prompt, every tool call, every decision is on the record. So you can trust what they did.
It runs on your own machine, with any model. Local or cloud.
Pantheon. Free and open source. Try it today.
